claims.text: The source defines CoDi: independent per-modality latent diffusion models (image SD1.5, video plus pseudo-temporal plus latent-shift, audio mel-as-image plus AudioLDM-VAE/vocoder, text OPTIMUS/GPT-2) with text-bridged prompt encoders fused by weighted interpolation; joint generation adds frozen-model cross-attention plus contrastively-aligned environment encoders projecting latents, trained linearly (text-image to text-audio to video-audio) enabling unseen combinations.

Reported numbers: AudioCaps text-to-audio FD 22.90 vs AudioLDM-L-Full 23.31, IS 8.77 vs 8.13, KL 1.40 vs 1.59, FAD 1.80 vs 1.96; text-to-image COCO FID 11.26 vs SD1.4 11.21; joint similarity joint-vs-independent e.g. video-audio 0.255 vs 0.240; captioning near state-of-the-art.
